description: Tech Stack Checker. Return hosting, frameworks, analytics, payments, and mail setup for a company website. Checks a stored fingerprint first, then a fresh live read when live=true. Accepts a URL or a plain domain. Costs 1 credit. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

live.description: When true, force a fresh live scan even if a cached DB fingerprint exists.
